name: Nova Modular
author: RackDroid Nova fork
description: Mutable Instruments modules that Audible Instruments does not have, built from the original firmware. Based on BrickRack.

modules.name: Macro Oscillator 2 (24 models)
modules.description: Based on Mutable Instruments Plaits, firmware 1.2: the 16 original models plus the 8 added later (6-op FM, wave terrain, string machine, chiptune...)

modules.name: Texture Synthesizer 2
modules.description: Based on Mutable Instruments Beads: granular processor, delay and reverb, with a wavetable synth when nothing is patched in

modules.name: Dual Trigger Converter
modules.description: Based on Mutable Instruments Peaks: two channels of envelopes, LFOs, tap LFO, drums, sequencer and pulse tools

modules.name: Quad Chiptune Oscillator
modules.description: Based on Mutable Instruments Edges: three timer-based pulse oscillators and a NES-style triangle/noise voice

modules.name: Dual Multimode Filter
modules.description: Based on Mutable Instruments Blades: two multimode filters with drive, in parallel or in series (a digital model of the analog circuit)

modules.name: Nova Play
modules.description: The controller, the sensors and the touch surfaces of a handheld as voltages, with eight slots for combinations of buttons and for moving knobs. On a computer, a gamepad.
